title: Yulong Homebrew
description: A small collection of PF2e homebrew and compatibility tweaks: provides a troop single-target damage cap, adds GM-reviewed area weakness multiplier cards for qualifying troop area damage, forwards PF2e Toolbelt Target Helper damage/healing applications to PF2e Holodeck analytics, improves Automatic Achievements attribution for PF2e damage, healing, kills, GM rolls, and item use, supports patreon-v3 low-HP incapacitation handling, adds a hideable Fumble Switch floating widget, and quantizes PF2e HUD health colors to status bands.
